reasoning.summary: The document is a Distribution and Development Agreement between Sekisui Diagnostics, LLC and Qualigen, Inc., dated May 1, 2016. Key obligations include exclusivity in distribution, supply commitments, financing payments for development, IP ownership assignments, audit rights, insurance requirements, and specific termination and renewal terms. The agreement contains detailed provisions regarding the Sale Transaction (Change of Control/ROFR), non-compete/exclusivity during the Exclusivity Period, and post-termination effects.

reasoning.summary: The document is a Co-Development Agreement between PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals Inc. and SFJ Pharmaceuticals X, Ltd., effective January 9, 2020. The agreement covers the co-development of a product (PB2452) for the reversal of Ticagrelor effects. Key obligations include clinical trial conduct, regulatory approvals, and financial payments. The term expires upon the last Approval Payment or termination. Termination clauses cover breach, at-will by PB, material adverse events, failure to receive approval, bankruptcy, change of control, safety concerns, compliance breaches, patent impact, and JSC decisions. Governing law is Delaware.
